title: Connect Facebook Pages and Instagram Professional accounts
description: RecruitOps uses Meta's official authorization flow. Provider tokens stay server-side and only accounts you explicitly select are promoted into publishing destinations.
targetsLegend: Choose which Meta capabilities to authorize
facebookHint: Discover Pages you manage and connect selected Pages as API publishing destinations.
instagramHint: Discover Professional Instagram accounts linked to your Facebook Pages. Consumer accounts are not supported by this flow.
authorizationDenied: Meta authorization was cancelled. No account was connected.
chooseAccounts: Authorization succeeded. Select the exact accounts RecruitOps may connect.
facebookDestinationHint: Creates or reconnects an API destination for this Page.
instagramDestinationHint: Connect the Professional account linked to this Page.
instagramNotLinked: No Instagram Professional account is linked to this Page.
noAccounts: Meta did not return any eligible accounts for the selected capabilities.
chooseTarget: Select Facebook, Instagram, or both before continuing.
chooseAtLeastOne: Select at least one account to connect.
startFailed: RecruitOps could not start Meta authorization. Check integration configuration and try again.
selectionLoadFailed: The Meta account-selection session is unavailable or expired. Start authorization again.
confirmFailed: The selected Meta accounts could not be connected. The temporary session remains retryable while it is valid.
missingApiConfig: The frontend API connection is not configured.
signInRequired: Sign in to connect social accounts.
ownerAdminRequired: Only OWNER and ADMIN accounts can manage social account connections.
